title: A vendor event never arrives
description: A Talkdesk or Salesforce event the platform waits for is never delivered (the emulator drops it); the platform must time out, reconcile against the vendor API and never infer the missing state.
callerVisible: The caller stays connected while the transfer is checked; a fallback route is used if the receiver cannot be confirmed.
backendEvidence: Watermark/timeout record for the missing event
Reconciliation call to the vendor API
No state advanced without its event or an authoritative read
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:MISSING_WEBHOOK] owned by WP-29 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: a vendor event that never arrives (Talkdesk/Salesforce emulator drops it)

postconditions: The missing state is never inferred
A reconciliation read against the vendor API runs after the timeout
